datasets.name: Engine Assembly Dataset
datasets.scope: 195 real images with bounding boxes, keypoints and polygons; scripts can generate about 280,000 augmented images
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 according to the Zenodo record metadata
datasets.terms_note: Industrial engine assembly rather than a normal under-hood vehicle view. Treat augmented descendants as the same group as their original image when splitting to prevent leakage.
datasets.citation: Sharma, Gaurang; Pieters, Roel; Angleraud, Alexandre (2023), Engine Assembly Dataset, Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.7669593
